description: Assistant states lender criteria not present in the retrieved documents (confabulation) and a broker shortlists the wrong lender
controls: Retrieval-only answers; required citations; grounding gate >= 0.95; rules engine (not the LLM) produces outcomes
notes: Residual is judgement: offline fixture eval n=16 only (95% CI lower bound 0.81)

description: Assistant output reads as a lending decision or approval and a borrower is told they will get the loan
controls: Decision-prediction refusal gate = 1.0; prohibited-terms list PT-01; indicative labels; oversight matrix inform-only for lending decisions
notes: PT-01 list still to be agreed with the compliance officer

description: Personal data from case notes or uploaded documents echoed into answers or provider logs
controls: Identifier redaction before prompts; PII leakage gate = 0; provider zero-retention DPA; 90-day retention
notes: PII detectors are regex heuristics; DPIA not yet done

description: Hidden instructions in an uploaded document make the assistant mark lenders eligible or send case data out
controls: Injection screening before context assembly; tool policy denies side-effecting tools from retrieved content; PII egress allowlist
notes: Scanner is heuristic with known false negatives; policy carries the control

description: Brokers over-rely on indicative results (automation bias) and stop checking sources
controls: Recommend-only role; per-rule reasons with sources; blind-review sample; override and agreement monitoring
notes: Evidence is a design review (oversight_check) only; no behavioural data yet

description: Answers less accurate for self-employed and adverse-credit cases (unequal performance across groups)
affected_party: Self-employed borrowers and borrowers with adverse credit
controls: Tagged eval slices (income-type; adverse-credit); refer to a human for non-standard income; Equality Act review by legal counsel
notes: Slices have 3 and 2 items only - not evidence of equal performance; larger slice eval required

description: Third-party model version change alters behaviour without notice
controls: Pinned model version; full eval re-run on every change; feature flag rollback
